question: Who among the following was the first Law and Justice Minister of independent India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BR Ambedkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **BR Ambedkar** was the first Law and Justice Minister of independent India.
 
• He served as the Chairman of the Drafting Committee for the Indian Constitution.
 
• Ambedkar played a crucial role in framing the laws and policies for the newly independent nation.
 
• He was a key architect in establishing the legal and social framework of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Law and Justice Ministry**:

 
 
• The Ministry is responsible for the administration of justice, legal reforms, and legal advice to the Government of India.
 
• It oversees the functioning of the legal and judicial system in the country.
 
 
 
• **Indian Constitution**:
 
 
• The Constitution of India was adopted on 26 January 1950.
 
• It is the supreme law of India and provides the framework for the political principles, procedures, and powers of government institutions.
 
 
 
• **Drafting Committee**:
 
 
• The Drafting Committee was formed on 29 August 1947 to draft the Constitution of India.
 
• BR Ambedkar was appointed as the Chairman of this committee.
 
 
 
• **Social Reforms**:
 
 
• Ambedkar was a prominent social reformer and fought against social discrimination and the caste system.
 
• He played a significant role in uplifting the downtrodden and marginalized sections of society.
